headline.text: L1 S2 matrix finger missing from 04:30—*X-ray caught test cards* but actual finger remained in product path until found 16 hours later.

summary: Two metal-in-product events: S2 jar line finger missing 04:30–20:45, S3 X-ray failed test-card verification at 07:30. Both lines placed product on hold. S3 Russell Finex pin and fan blade broke—all pieces accounted for.

holds.title: S2 jar line—product from 04:30 for missing finger
holds.summary: Matrix 7 bag-opening finger missing, last verified present at 04:30; all product from that time held pending investigation.
holds.status: Resolved at 20:45—finger found at end of conveyor C15, no product contact confirmed.

holds.title: S3 jar line—pallets back to last X-ray check
holds.summary: X-ray failed to reject test cards during routine verification; all pallets from previous passing check placed on hold.
holds.status: Open, awaiting maintenance resolution and pallet inspection.

holds.title: S2 jar line—5 pallets for salt coverage
holds.summary: Five pallets held due to salt loss on finished caramel pieces; tunnel and temper adjustments made, later product within spec.
holds.status: On hold pending salt-coverage inspection and disposition.

food_safety.title: S2 matrix bag-opening finger missing 16 hours
food_safety.summary: Matrix 7 finger missing from 04:30, not found during shift searches; X-ray detected test finger but actual part remained in product path until 20:45.
food_safety.status: Resolved—finger found at conveyor discharge C15 at 20:45, outside product contact zone.

food_safety.title: S3 X-ray not rejecting test cards
food_safety.summary: X-ray failed to reject test cards with metal inserts during QA verification at 07:30; root cause unknown.
food_safety.status: Open, maintenance troubleshooting, all product since last passing test on hold.

food_safety.title: S3 Russell Finex pin and fan blade broke
food_safety.summary: Vibrating-screen drive pin and motor-fan blade fractured during operation; pieces could have entered chocolate system.
food_safety.status: Resolved—all broken pieces accounted for, filter inspected and cleared, production resumed.

quality.title: S2 caramel salt not adhering
quality.summary: Heavy salt loss observed on finished salted-caramel pieces; tunnel temp raised and temper adjusted, 5 pallets held for inspection.
quality.status: Line adjustments made—later product meeting spec, early pallets on hold pending review.

quality.title: ML4 blooming on chocolate bars
quality.summary: 1 bar per 2 molds showing bloom at 09:31; supervisors adjusting depositor and tunnel temps, frequency decreased to 1 per 8–10 molds by 10:21.
quality.status: Resolved on shift—bloom size decreased, defective bars removed at demolding, no pallets held.

quality.title: S3 slip sheets oversized
quality.summary: Newly delivered slip sheets (same item number) are larger than those in use; could affect pallet stability if used as-is.
quality.status: Open—QA asked whether to trim to correct size or place on hold.

sanitation.title: Sanitizer bottle not in 5S location
sanitation.summary: Floor sanitizer bottle found out of designated shadow-board location during GMP walkthrough.
sanitation.status: Flagged to supervisors for corrective action.

opportunities.text: Consider adding matrix bag-finger inspection to S2 startup checklist—today's 16-hour missing-finger event (04:30–20:45) went undetected despite X-ray verification because the test card passed while the actual part was already in the product path.
Review X-ray verification frequency and escalation triggers at S3—today's test-card failure was caught by QA but root cause unknown, suggesting PM or calibration gap.
Review ML4 bloom-control SOP—today's event resolved by operators adjusting tunnel and temper settings, but formal troubleshooting steps may reduce response time.
